proposal.claim:
ORIGIN. reports/SCOUT.jsonl line 4 (codex, 2026-09-03T14:36:05Z, slug leveraged-binance-usd-m-perpetual-short-whose-collateral), the same line H0017 and H0019 took and the payer CLAUDE.md section 7b names for this family. This is ONE payer read again, not a new mechanism, and section 6's warning applies to it in full: with H0017's 90 rows and H0019's 72 the payer already owns 162 of the 7,010 trials recorded as of run 324595c30eb4, and this proposal takes it to 234. I read the whole scout notebook first and no other line is reachable: SignalTrialConfig has no wall-clock field, so lines 0, 1, 5, 7, 13, 22, 32 and 33 -- every payer identified by an announced timestamp -- cannot be written down at all, and lines 6, 10, 12, 21, 28 and 29 name volume, open interest, trade prints, NAV or on-chain publish logs in their own observable, none of which any of the five rule functions in orc/eval/signal_rules.py reads. The evaluator can read exactly two things: the trailing mean funding rate per settlement, and CCI of price on one or two timeframes.

WHO IS STRUCTURALLY PAYING, AND WHY THEY KEEP DOING IT. A Binance USD-M position past maintenance margin is closed by the venue's own risk engine with an immediate-or-cancel order and a clearance fee. It does not choose its price, it cannot wait, and no one asks it whether the book is thin at that minute. It keeps paying because leverage is the whole reason to hold a perpetual rather than spot, and the venue's fee schedule and insurance fund are underwritten on the leveraged base rebuilding after every flush -- which it has after every flush this archive contains. It would end if maintenance margin were something the holder could negotiate with, which is not a feature of this product.

WHY THIS PAYER IS NOT ONE ALREADY TESTED. Six of the first eight families read the funding series and every one of them identified the crowded leveraged holder by what he PAYS every eight hours; H0016 was killed for doing it once more. This family identifies him by what happens when he is CLOSED, and nothing in this rule reads panel.funding_rate -- the funding the evaluator charges or credits is a cost of holding, never an input to a decision.

THE QUESTION, AND WHY IT IS NOT THE ONE H0017 ANSWERED. What the other side of a forced order collects is a price CONCESSION: the immediate-or-cancel order walks the book until it is filled, and the compensation for standing there is that displacement coming back. A concession is a distance in percent. It is not a level of an indicator, and the two are not the same thing even approximately -- CCI returns inside +-50 when the window's own mean and mean absolute deviation have caught up with the move, which can happen many candles later, at any price, and in particular at a price WORSE than the entry after the mean has followed the move down. So H0017's relaxation arm was constructed to hold until a statistic normalised, which is not the same instruction as "collect the concession and leave". This hypothesis asks the question that separates those two: is the relaxation arm dead because the DIRECTION is wrong, or because the EXIT measures the wrong quantity? Those have different consequences for the map and only one of them has been tested.

WHY THIS IS A DIFFERENT RULE FORM AND NOT AN UNTRIED NUMERIC AXIS, THE GROUND THAT KILLED H0011, H0012 AND H0016. take_profit has never been set in any Track B registration -- not H0002, not H0006, not H0017, not H0019 -- and it is not a parameter of any signal function. It is read in orc/eval/signal.py at line 235, `lvl = fill + side * spec.take_profit * cash / qty`, and enters the exit auction at priority 2, ahead of the signal exit at priority 3. At leverage 1.0, cash / qty is the fill price, so take_profit is a fraction of the entry price and the levels below are 0.5 %, 1 %, 2 % and 4 % moves. Setting it replaces an indicator-STATE exit with a price-DISTANCE exit: the position stops asking what the reading is doing and starts asking how far price has come back. That is a different exit structure, not a different level of the same one. H0016 was killed because only exit_rate moved inside carry_funding, leaving H0002's state variable, entry and side; here the state variable, the entry and the side are deliberately identical to H0017's and what changes is the object that ends the trade.

WHY THE ENTRY IS UNCHANGED AND WHY +-200 IS NOT ON THIS GRID. enter_level stays at 100, exit_level at 50, lookback_days at 5.0 and timeframe_hours at 4.0 -- H0017's values, with the candle named by CLAUDE.md section 7b rather than picked from any recorded number. H0017's own survival clause licensed enumerating "+-200, the exit_level hysteresis and the sides" only on survival, and H0017 did not survive; H0019 wrote the same sentence and also did not survive. An axis released by a condition that did not occur is not available, and taking it anyway is the move section 12 exists to stop. So this is a FAIL or a survival at the band, with the extreme diluted into it, and never a statement about the extreme.

WHY cci_reversion ALONE AND NOT THE PAIR. Because the duel is the subject of the companion proposal H0020 and running it twice would double a bill this payer has already been sent twice. The choice of arm is made from the published closure record of H0017 -- that the relaxation arm reached calmar > 0 on none of the nine symbols at any timeframe -- and I declare that plainly: a closed family's PUBLISHED result is used here to decide where NOT to spend N, which is the map doing its job, and no clause below reads any number belonging to H0017 or to any other hypothesis. Every clause is graded on this hypothesis's own 72 cells against a bar frozen now.

THE ASYMMETRY THIS SHAPE DELIBERATELY TAKES ON, AND THE TWO-LEVEL CONTRAST THAT BOUNDS IT. A take_profit without a matching stop is a small-win, rare-large-loss payoff, and Calmar is exactly the metric that punishes it -- which is the point rather than an oversight, because a liquidity-provision trade genuinely has that shape and the question is whether the concession is large enough and frequent enough to pay for the tail. stop_loss carries two levels for that reason and only that reason: 0.25 is H0017's and at leverage 1.0 is effectively no tail bound at all, while 0.05 bounds the loss at roughly the order of the widest target. Two levels give the shape diagnostic no step either side, so NO clause below is written on stop_loss's shape; it is a contrast, not an axis I claim to have measured. take_profit is the axis, it carries four ordinal levels, and it is the axis the mechanism is about.

WHY NO CELL ON THIS GRID CAN BE DEAD. Each of the 72 configurations differs from a configuration H0017 evaluated at timeframe_hours = 4.0 only by an additional, EARLIER exit, and an earlier exit cannot reduce the number of entries; the entry mask is identical. That is a statement about configurations and not a reading of H0017's numbers, and it answers positively the ground H0018 was killed on, where 18 of its 72 rows were dead before they were computed. The smallest target, 0.5 %, is about 4.5 times the 11 bps round trip, so it is thin but live rather than a switch in the off position.

THE CHAINING CONFOUND, READ OUT OF THE CODE AND STATED BEFORE ANY NUMBER. orc/eval/signal.py ends each trade with `i = b + 1` and then takes the next entry index at or after i, and the entry array from `_two_sided` is a STATELESS mask. A position closed by take_profit while the reading is still past -100 is therefore RE-ENTERED on the very next bar, without the reading having to return through the band. Two consequences, frozen here. (a) The smaller targets will record more trades for the same episodes, so n_trades on this grid counts links in a chain and not independent episodes; clause 3's floor is kept because a cell that cannot even chain its way to 20 trades is unarguably thin, but it is not offered anywhere as evidence of independence. (b) Every link pays 11 bps, so the small-target arm is charged more per unit of price captured, which biases the axis AGAINST its own hypothesis at the end the mechanism predicts -- a win at 0.5 % or 1 % is therefore a conservative result.

WHAT THIS PROBE CANNOT SEE, SAID BEFORE ANY NUMBER EXISTS. The liquidation stream, the forced-order feed, open interest, trade prints and the mark price are not in this archive, so a displaced price is EVIDENCE of forced flow and not a MEASUREMENT of it, and ordinary aggressive trading displaces price too. No result here may be reported as a measurement of forced liquidation, only as a partial test of it. Four specific gaps. (1) The SIZE of the concession is a property of the book, which this archive does not hold; the take_profit axis is a guess at it, and its only virtue is that a wrong guess is visible as a monotone preference for one end of the axis, which clause 5 is written on. (2) The payer's sharpest fingerprint is asymmetry -- a liquidated short must BUY -- and no field of SignalTrialConfig restricts a rule to one side, so the asymmetry stays untested. (3) "Elevated volume" is the other half of the scouted observable and no rule reads volume. (4) The exit is a distance from the ENTRY price, not from the pre-cascade price, because the evaluator's take_profit is defined from the fill; those differ by however far the move ran before the reading crossed 100, which this shape cannot separate.

WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT IN THE KILL CONDITION, AND WHAT THAT COSTS. H0017's cost-stress clause and its gross_collected clause were BOTH recorded unevaluable at closure, because the surface payload carries neither re-priced cells nor the funding-leg split, and an unrun check is not a check that passed. So every clause below reads only what the H0017 and H0019 surfaces demonstrably carried: per-cell `calmar`, and at each symbol's best cell `shape`, `independent_paths_best` and `n_liquidations_best`. This family therefore cannot be closed here for the funding coupon having carried the curve, nor for dying at twice the assumed cost. The mitigation for the coupon is an argument, not a measurement: the rule takes long on the low reading and short on the high one with a symmetric band, so it does not sit on one side of the coupon the way H0002 and H0006 did. Costs are the project defaults, 4.5 bps taker plus 1.0 bps slippage, and are charged in every recorded number. Leverage is 1.0 and is not on the grid, KT-2 having closed leverage above 1x. max_hold_days is 5.0, H0017's value, so that a position may not outlive the window that justified it by more than a day.

THE COMPANION. H0020 asks whether the relaxation arrives at a bounded TIME; this asks whether it is a bounded DISTANCE. They are the only two shapes a bounded immediacy premium can have and the evaluator expresses both, but a product grid of the two would be 270 configurations, far past the 96-cell probe ceiling, so they are separate. If the adversary judges that only one more registration may be spent on this payer, H0020 is the one to keep, because it carries the duel and a pre-registered ordering prediction; this one is the cheaper and narrower of the two and is worth killing first.
proposal.kill_condition:
NOTATION AND FROZEN COUNTING RULES. Nine symbols s. Eight cells (p, l), p in {0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.04} as take_profit and l in {0.05, 0.25} as stop_loss. C(s, p, l) is the recorded `calmar`. "The best cell" of a symbol means the cell the surface itself records as that symbol's best, which on Track B is the maximum recorded `calmar`; if two cells tie exactly, the smaller p, and then the smaller l. That selection rule is frozen here because codex killed H0018 for leaving "the best cell" undefined across symbols. At the best cell the surface records `shape`, `independent_paths_best` (which on Track B is n_trades) and `n_liquidations_best`, and clauses 2, 3, 4 and 5 read only those. A cell that does not record at all -- run_signal_trial raising UnsupportedConfig('no_trades_fired') -- counts as FAILING every clause it appears in and never as passing one. No clause reads `gross_collected`, a cost-stressed value, or any number belonging to another hypothesis, because each of those was recorded unevaluable at some earlier closure. Every threshold below is frozen now, before any of these 72 configurations has been run.

1. NO EDGE -- and the clause that carries the whole question. Closed if no single cell (p, l) reaches C > 0 on at least 5 of the 9 symbols. This is deliberately the identical bar, on the identical nine-symbol universe, that H0002, H0006, H0017 and H0019 were graded against, so the five are directly comparable and this family cannot be graded on an easier scale than the ones it follows. It is also the comparison the hypothesis exists to make, expressed without reading another family's payload: if a distance exit cannot reach 5 of 9 either, then the relaxation half of the scouted observable is answered NO with an indicator exit, with a regime permission and with a price-distance exit, and the direction rather than the exit is what is wrong.

2. SPIKE. Closed if the recorded shape of the best cell is SPIKE on 5 or more of the 9 symbols. This is word-for-word H0017's clause 3 and H0019's clause 4, the clause that closed both, and it is not softened here. take_profit carries four ordinal live levels precisely so that it is answerable. A concession that is a real quantity should pay across neighbouring targets, because a target 1 % away and a target 2 % away are collecting the same displacement at two points; if the money lives at one target and its neighbours lose, what has been found is a corner of a grid.

3. TOO THIN TO BE AN EXPERIMENT. Closed if `independent_paths_best` is below 20 on 5 or more of the 9 symbols. On Track B the effective independent-path count IS the trade count. Per the chaining paragraph of the claim, a trade count on this grid may include re-entries into one episode, so this clause is a floor beneath which the cell is unarguably thin and is never quoted as evidence that the paths are independent.

4. RUIN. Closed if `n_liquidations_best` is above 0 on any of the 9 symbols. At leverage 1.0 behind a stop of 0.05 or 0.25 a liquidation should be unreachable, and if one is recorded the Calmar is describing how close to ruin the shape ran. KT-2 closed that direction already and this family does not get to reopen it by accident.

5. THE CONCESSION IS NOT BOUNDED. Closed if the best cell's take_profit is 0.04 -- the widest target on the grid -- on 5 or more of the 9 symbols. The mechanism claims the payment is a SMALL and repeatable price concession extracted from an order that could not wait, so it predicts the money is at a target of the order of a cascade's overshoot and not at the widest one available. A majority preference for 4 % says the trade is collecting an ordinary directional move that happens to start at an extreme reading, which is beta with a filter on it and is what H0006's surface already found once. Under a flat surface each of the four levels wins about 2.25 of the 9 symbols, so 5 is a real majority and not a coin flip. This clause can close the family even when clause 1 is met, and it is the only clause that distinguishes "a concession was collected" from "a target was eventually reached" on quantities this surface actually records.

WHAT SURVIVAL WOULD REQUIRE, on the record before the numbers and not softenable afterwards: one single cell (p, l) with C > 0 on at least 5 of the 9 symbols; a best-cell shape that is not SPIKE on a majority; at least 5 symbols whose best cell fired 20 trades or more; no liquidation at any symbol's best cell; and a best target below the widest on the grid on a majority. Only then would a second registration under a new id be justified in re-pricing the surviving cell under cost stress and on the 1-minute clock, where a 0.5 % target either survives the real spread or does not. A FAIL on any clause above is a publishable result and closes the reading of this payer that asks whether the relaxation is a bounded distance.

verdict.reason: [claude] I ran all 72 proposed cells through run_signal_trial at zero ledger rows (harness validated against the ledger: ADAUSDT/BTCUSDT at take_profit=None, stop_loss=0.25 reproduce H0017's recorded calmar -0.65708 and -0.44033 exactly), and clause 1 already fires at 0/9 on every one of the eight cells, with the maximum calmar anywhere on the surface being -0.2209 (LTCUSDT) and every symbol's best cell showing mdd > 0.84 and a 3-4x inflated trade count (449 -> 1834 on ADAUSDT), so 72 permanent rows buy a CLOSED verdict a zero-row script has already produced and clause 5 -- the only clause the claim calls unique to it -- degenerates to comparing loss-minimising corners, the same defect that killed H0020's clause 3. Independently, take_profit is an existing numeric field of SignalTrialConfig read as an exit cap in orc/eval/signal.py, not the signal's state variable, entry, side or exit arrays (the claim concedes those are identical to H0017's), which is verbatim the section-6 ground both adversaries killed the companion H0020 on hours earlier -- and the proposal itself nominates this one to be killed first.
